entries.4f36e00b65d0a4cf: The company is headquartered in Onojo, Fukuoka Prefecture, and is engaged in the planning, development, design and sale of electric medical and nursing care beds and bed peripheral equipment such as mattresses. The group consists of 2 consolidated subsidiaries, Fu Ruo Ci (Shanghai) Trading Co., Ltd., which sells products in China, and Yamato Sangyo Co., Ltd., which processes and sells urethane foam, and 1 equity-method affiliate that manufactures in Vietnam.
